blocks.html: Robinsons Hotels and Resorts (RHR), the hospitality arm of Robinsons Land Corporation, is bringing together its diverse portfolio of hotel brands under one roof for the first Robinsons Hotels and Resorts Travel Fair, happening from October 16 to 18, 2026 at the Main Atrium of Robinsons Galleria.

As the Philippines' largest and most diversified hospitality group, RHR operates 10 brands and 30 properties across 20 cities and municipalities nationwide, offering a wide range of hospitality experiences, from ultra-luxury and upscale hotels to full-service and essential-value accommodations.

Guided by the theme "Reasons to Travel," the three-day event gives travelers the opportunity to discover great destinations, enjoy exclusive deals, and explore RHR’s diverse collection of hotel brands suited for every travel style and budget.

Participating are NUSTAR Cebu, Fili at NUSTAR Cebu, Grand Summit General Santos, Summit Hotels and Resorts, Go Hotels, and Go Hotels Plus, alongside international brands Crowne Plaza Manila Galleria, Holiday Inn & Suites Manila Galleria, The Westin Manila, and Dusit Thani Mactan Cebu.

Complementing the hotels are travel and lifestyle partners from the broader Gokongwei ecosystem, including Cebu Pacific, GoTyme Bank, and Go Rewards, as well as Union Bank -- creating a convenient one-stop destination for travel planning.
What visitors can look forward to:

items: Exclusive room and dining vouchers at special Travel Fair rates
Travel Fair-only wedding, meeting, and event offers
A Go Rewards promotion that will allow members to redeem points at 50% fewer points required
Go Rewards points earning opportunities through GoTyme Bank
Exciting giveaways and purchase incentives and perks
Signature baked creations and premium coffee offerings
An Events section highlighting ballrooms and function venues across participating hotel brands

blocks.html: "This Travel Fair is designed not only to offer great value but also to inspire more Filipinos to explore the country,” says Barun Jolly, Senior Vice President and Business Unit General Manager of Robinsons Hotels and Resorts. “Beyond familiar destinations, the Philippines is home to many remarkable experiences -- from the majestic waterfalls of Iligan and the surf spots of Tacloban to the pristine sandbars of Kalanggaman Island and the natural wonders of Callao Cave in Cagayan.

“Through our portfolio of hotels, we hope to encourage travelers to discover new places and experience more of what the country has to offer. And together with our partners, we aim to provide a more convenient and rewarding way to plan travel, from flights and accommodations to banking and loyalty rewards -- all in one place," he explains.

Guests will also be able to enjoy samples of signature baked creations sold at special prices from Café Summit, the signature dining outlet of Grand Summit and Summit Hotels and Resorts; as well as from The Westin Manila and Crowne Plaza Manila Galleria. R Coffee, Robinsons Hotels and Resorts' signature coffee brand, will also be featured.

Jolly adds, "Food is an important part of every travel experience, and the Travel Fair gives guests a taste of the culinary offerings they can look forward to across our hotels. From artisanal pastries and baked specialties to our signature R Coffee, we want visitors to experience the flavors and hospitality that define our brands."

In addition, the fair will feature an Events section, where guests can explore wedding, social, and corporate event venues from across the portfolio. From grand ballrooms to versatile function spaces, attendees can discover various options from multiple hotel brands in one visit and access special event packages available during the travel fair.

Whether planning a family getaway, business trip, dream wedding, special celebration, or simply looking for the best travel deals, visitors will find plenty of reasons to attend the Robinsons Hotels and Resorts “Reasons to Travel” Travel Fair on October 16-18, 2026 at Robinsons Galleria’s Main Atrium.
